ads.headline: Meta Ads interest at 24/100—opportunity window before seasonal surge hits
actions: Launch 3 test campaigns today at $25/day each to establish baseline CTR/CPC before competition increases
Document current cost-per-lead by service type (plumbing vs landscaping) to have benchmark data when prices rise
Build 2-3 audience segments now while CPM is likely lower than peak season
ads.source: Google Trends meta ads 24/100 baseline + r/FacebookAds weekly pattern analysis

creative.headline: Can't generate reliable recommendations — data shows zero engagement signals
actions: WAIT — your Google Trends data is all zeros and complaints section is empty
You need: actual view counts, engagement rates, comment themes, and DM conversion data from your recent posts to identify what's working
Without real performance metrics, any recommendation would be a guess that wastes your filming time
creative.source: Incomplete data set — recommend pulling last 7-14 days of native Instagram Insights (reach, saves, shares, profile visits, DMs) plus top 3-5 performing post captions to analyze actual patterns

critic.headline: Most failing ads this week have no clear offer — just a service name
actions: Open your current ad — does it have a specific outcome and deadline, or just your service name?
If your CTA is 'Learn More' or 'Contact Us' — change it to 'Get a Free Quote' or similar action
Check your click-to-lead rate: if under 15%, your offer is the problem, not the audience

competitors.headline: No one is teaching service businesses HOW to respond to leads from ads
actions: Uncovered angle: competitors teach how to get leads but never what to say when the lead comes in — film 'exact script I tell my clients to use when someone fills in the form'
Pain point from this week: 'I got leads from my ads but none of them booked' — hook: 'You got leads but nobody booked. Here is exactly why and how to fix it in one message'
Top accounts posting 3-4x per week minimum with one Reel hitting 10k+ views acting as top of funnel — post volume is the differentiator right now
